summary.zh-TW: 一串方塊跟著游標，越後面的跟得越慢、越小越淡，連成一條會甩動的尾巴；按住滑鼠時尾巴收緊、方塊轉 45°，停下一下就淡出。
summary.en: A chain of squares follows the cursor, each one slower, smaller and fainter than the last, forming a tail that swings. Holding the button tightens the tail and turns the squares 45°; pause and it fades out.

text.zh-TW: 每一節各自一組 quickTo，只差在跟上的秒數：第一節幾乎黏著游標，越後面越慢。不用計算物理，快慢差就自然甩出一條尾巴。
text.en: Each segment has its own quickTo, differing only in how long it takes to catch up: the first nearly sticks to the cursor, later ones lag more. No physics needed, the timing difference alone swings out a tail.

text.zh-TW: quickTo 回傳的函式身上有 .tween，按住時直接把速度調成 3 倍、放開調回 1，不用重建補間。
text.en: The function quickTo returns carries .tween; holding the button sets its timeScale to 3 and releasing sets it back to 1, with no tweens rebuilt.

text.zh-TW: 每次移動都重新計時，停下 1.2 秒才淡出；尾巴不會在游標停下時一直掛在畫面上。
text.en: Every move restarts the timer and the tail fades after 1.2 s of stillness, so it doesn't linger when the cursor stops.

text.zh-TW: 方塊的 left、top 都是 0，只用 x、y 移動，再用 -50% 讓中心對準游標；全部是 transform，不會重排版面。
text.en: Squares sit at left/top 0 and move only with x/y, with -50% centring them on the cursor; all transform, no layout.

text.zh-TW: 範圍裡把系統游標藏起來，第一節方塊就是游標。拖尾是純裝飾，不影響點擊；在網站上使用時，觸控和「減少動態」都應該關掉。
text.en: The system cursor is hidden inside the area and the first square becomes the cursor. The trail is pure decoration and doesn't affect clicks; on a real site turn it off for touch and reduced motion.
